verdict.rationale: Publishing on non-US startup instruments is a fair question for a startup law firm, so the axis applies. The pack shows no such content: VLP's equity-compensation material is US-centric (IRC Sections 409A and 280G, stock option plans), and nothing mentions UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules or French BSPCE. Its only foreign-law references concern data protection (GDPR, PIPEDA) and foreign trademark filings, which are not startup financing or equity instruments.
